description: Source code for the CompensatoryLeaveRequest class in ERPNext, handling compensatory leave requests including validation, submission, cancellation, and leave allocation management.

classes.name: CompensatoryLeaveRequest
classes.description: A Document class representing a compensatory leave request with methods for validation, submission, cancellation, and leave allocation management.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the compensatory leave request, including employee status, date ranges, overlap, holidays, attendance, and leave type.

methods.name: validate_attendance
methods.description: Checks if the employee was present for all days within the leave period.

methods.name: validate_holidays
methods.description: Ensures the leave days are valid holidays for the employee.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Handles logic when the leave request is submitted, including leave allocation and ledger entry creation.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles logic when the leave request is canceled, including reversing leave allocations and ledger entries.

methods.name: get_existing_allocation_for_period
methods.description: Retrieves existing leave allocation for the specified leave period.

methods.name: create_leave_allocation
methods.description: Creates a new leave allocation for the employee within the specified leave period.
